message: Architecture block discovery paused before VHDL generation. The reviewer judged the auto-discovered block contracts as a poor fit.

issues.message: Discovered blocks: branch_handler, instruction_fetch_unit. Missing blocks after review: instruction_decoder, alu, register_file, control_unit, program_memory_interface, data_memory_interface, cpu_top. Risks: Reset polarity mismatch: User request specifies synchronous active-high reset, but discovered blocks use rst_ni (active-low).; Discovered blocks lack data/address buses required for memory and register interfaces.; Critical CPU components (ALU, RegFile, Decoder) are missing from the discovered set.; Generic FSM wrappers may not provide necessary control signals for a complete CPU datapath..
